pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Surveyor's Eye, growing with the tier, up to +3.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 4.

Will not count without:$(li)12 of any impermeable$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Lodestone$(li)Bell$(li)any climbable$(li)any impermeable$(li)Glass Pane$(p)Counts against it:$(li)Water$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Windows encloses the room, and way up runs in a line of at least 3, best at 5, and sight is within 6 of windows.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Windows: any impermeable$(li)Way up: any climbable$(li)Sight: Lodestone or Bell
pages.title: How you arrange it
